name: FOOTBALL
description: Football is a high-action Poker variant based on Seven Card Stud, themed around American Football. It is characterized by its numerous wild cards and the 'extra boost' mechanics that mirror scoring in football. In this game, 3s and 6s are wild, and 2s give an extra card when dealt face-up. It is an extremely volatile game where hand rankings frequently reach Five-of-a-Kind, making it a staple of casual Dealer's Choice poker nights.

content.text: Football is a high-action Poker variant based on Seven Card Stud, themed around American Football. It is characterized by its numerous wild cards and the 'extra boost' mechanics that mirror scoring in football. In this game, 3s and 6s are wild, and 2s give an extra card when dealt face-up. It is an extremely volatile game where hand rankings frequently reach Five-of-a-Kind, making it a staple of casual Dealer's Choice poker nights.

Derived from the older Poker variant 'Baseball,' Football adapted the 'sportndthemed wild card' concept to focus on different numeric values. It emerged in midnd20th century American home games as a more complex and highndscoring alternative to standard Stud.
2 to 6 players. Limited to 6 due to the 'extra card' rule potentially exhausting the deck.
Standard Seven Card Stud format: 2 cards face-down, 4 cards face-up, 1 final card face-down.
